text:
Elaine: Heads up — after updating our staging nodes to NVIDIA driver 535.86.05 + CUDA 12.5p2 I'm seeing a sharp KV cache eviction spike on small-batch chat flows. P95 latency up ~25% on the nightly harness. Repro below.

Tariq: Ugh. Can you paste the perf CI failure link?

Elaine: https://ci.redwood/inference/perf/1901 — baseline vs current diff attached. Quick profiling snippet from perf-run: 
```text
kv_cache_evictions: 128 -> 512
matmul_ms: 0.9 -> 1.4
chosen_kernel: attention_fused_v2 -> attention_unfused_v1
```

Sam: Interesting — kernel selector flipped for seq_len=64 small batch. Could be a Triton heuristic change after the nvrtc/driver bump. :thinking_face:

ci-bot: perf-checker — regression detected (p95 latency +23%). Suspect commit range: 4a2b..7d9f. Bisect job started: https://ci.redwood/inference/bisect/190120

Tariq: Started a local bisect now. Early signal: reverting PR 7d9f (triton: adjust kernel-priority heuristics) removes the regression on our bench nodes. Running more iterations to be sure.

Michael: If bisect confirms, hold the driver upgrade in staging. That upgrade was scheduled for next-week rollout. This is a rollout blocker.

Elaine: Repro script in case others want to run quickly: 
```bash
# repro minimal
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
python benchmarks/replicate_chat.py --model gpt-small --batch 2 --seq 64 --iters 200
```

Sam: Also observed increased memcpy stalls in Nsight profiler. Call stack shows memcpy -> kernel_launch -> select_kernel_priority decision. Looks like selection change increases unfused attention path usage which hurts small-batch latency and thrashes KV cache.

Elaine: Can we try forcing the old kernel priority list as a temporary runtime config? I can add a flag to force the legacy order.

Tariq: Pushed a local patch to force legacy priority; quick run shows p95 back to baseline. I'll open an opt-in runtime toggle PR and run full perf matrix. ETA a couple hours.

Ops: Adding a rollout hold and marking the driver upgrade as rollout-blocked. Will notify infra owners. :no_entry: 

ci-bot: bisect complete — culprit identified: PR 7d9f (triton: kernel-priority tuning). Recommendation: revert or gate the heuristic behind a runtime flag.

Sam: Filing revert PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321 — if it lands we'll re-run the perf pipeline and unblock the upgrade.

Tariq: Running smoke perf after the revert branch build. Will update scheduling for next canary.

Elaine: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the rollout blocker discussion. :thumbsup:
